messages:
sam: Quick Q — working on smoke tests for the new per-route quota headers. Do we require that a 429 always includes X-Quota-Bucket and X-Quota-Remaining? Or is it optional when it's a runtime fallback? Need to know for client SDKs.
lee: short answer: we try to include hint headers when available, but there are cases (global fallback) where only Retry-After may be present. SDKs should handle both.
tara: +1. Also note we recently added X-Quota-Burst to describe burst window; not always populated for legacy routes.
oliver: Are there explicit compat guarantees? i.e., will headers ever change name or format? trying to write robust parsing.
sam: Good call. I couldn't find a doc page — can we treat them as semantically stable strings but not strict JSON? parse as ints when present, otherwise null.
lee: That's our policy: header names are stable, numeric values are integers, bucket id is opaque string. We'll avoid adding new required headers.
tara: For canary, we'll emit both legacy and new headers for 2 weeks: `X-Quota-Bucket` + `X-Quota-Bucket-V2` so clients can migrate. Add to release notes.
sam: Nice. Is the canary window configurable per-customer? Important for Dedicated/private.
oliver: No, it's global for the control plane rollout, but Dedicated/private can opt-in earlier via flag. Ops can confirm.
deploy-bot: deploy 2024-06-18T21:12:00Z to prod: per-route-quota-headers v1.3 rolled out to 30%
lee: FYI for SDKs: handle missing header -> fallback to per-account rate-limit header, and fallback to 429 body {"quota_hint":"..."}. Keep tolerant parsing.
sam: ok I'll update smoke tests and add a test for "429 with only Retry-After + body hint"
tara: pinging docs/eng: can someone add a short blurb to API reference about optional headers? @oliver
oliver: happy to, will PR after lunch.
sam: thanks all :thumbsup:
